scripts.build:chrome: BROWSER=chrome vite build && cd dist && zip -r ../atpassport-extension-chrome.zip .
scripts.build:firefox: BROWSER=firefox vite build && cd dist && zip -r ../atpassport-extension-firefox.zip .
scripts.build: pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.update: pnpm dlx npm-check-updates -u -x eslint && pnpm install
scripts.deploy:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && source .env && web-ext sign --api-key $FIREFOX_ISSUER --api-secret $FIREFOX_SECRET --source-dir ./dist --artifacts-dir ./web-ext-artifacts --channel listed
scripts.deploy:chrome: pnpm run build:chrome && source .env && chrome-webstore-upload upload --source atpassport-extension-chrome.zip --extension-id $CHROME_EXTENSION_ID --client-id $CHROME_CLIENT_ID --client-secret $CHROME_CLIENT_SECRET --refresh-token $CHROME_REFRESH_TOKEN --auto-publish
